low_walking_itinerary.title: The Gentle Heritage Tour (Senior & Low-Mobility Edition)
low_walking_itinerary.subtitle: Curated for travelers who prefer minimal walking, zero steep climbs, and maximum comfort.
low_walking_itinerary.step_count_estimate: < 1,200 total steps (compared to 8,500+ for hiking caves)
low_walking_itinerary.vehicle_drop_offs: All drop-offs within 30 to 50 meters of attractions

timeline.highlights: Explore the 8th-century royal coronation temples along a smooth, level flagstone loop. Shaded benches every 40 meters under mature neem trees.
timeline.comfort_tip: Ask ASI staff at ticket counter for the complimentary wheelchair if you prefer to be pushed through the gardens.
timeline.accessible_washroom: Yes, modern accessible sanitation block at entrance

timeline.highlights: Pull up directly to the door. Sit comfortably in chairs while master artisans demonstrate the UNESCO/GI-tagged Ilkal saree weaving on wooden pit looms.
timeline.comfort_tip: Artisans bring handloom samples directly to your seating area.

timeline.destination: Relaxed Traditional Lunch at KSTDC Mayura / Verified Khanavali
timeline.highlights: Authentic North Karnataka dining in comfortable air-cooled surroundings. Soft Jolada Rotti, stuffed brinjal (Ennegayi), Shenga chutney, curd, and mild dal.
timeline.comfort_tip: High-back dining chairs with armrests available; non-spicy customized options for seniors.

timeline.destination: Badami Agastya Lake & Cave Scenic Viewpoint (Drive-Up)
timeline.highlights: Instead of climbing 250 steep rock-cut stairs, your car drives directly to the scenic North Lake Bund near Bhootanatha Temple. Enjoy the panoramic cliff and cave views from level stone platforms.
timeline.comfort_tip: Excellent photo opportunities without climbing a single stair.
timeline.accessible_washroom: Yes, at Badami Tourist Information Plaza

timeline.highlights: Board the campus electric battery buggy from the parking lot. Disembark at the Sangameshwara Temple and take the ramp or lift to the Aikya Mantapa riverside promenade.
timeline.comfort_tip: Enjoy the cool evening river breeze from covered stone pavilions with drinking water kiosks.
timeline.accessible_washroom: Yes, 3 fully accessible disabled washroom complexes

rest_areas.name: Pattadakal Heritage Park Lawn Seating & Shade Canopies
rest_areas.description: Weather-treated wrought-iron and stone garden benches installed under mature neem, tamarind, and banyan tree canopies. Provides continuous natural shade, gentle breeze, and uninterrupted views of 8th-century temple spires.

rest_areas.name: Kudala Sangama Riverfront Pergolas & Gazebos
rest_areas.description: Over 1.5 km of beautifully landscaped riverfront promenades lined with covered stone pergolas, circular gazebos, and river-facing seating ledges where visitors can relax in the serene river breeze.

rest_areas.name: Almatti Dam Terrace Gardens & Amphitheater Seating
rest_areas.description: Tiered grass seating overlooking the dancing musical fountain, complemented by pergola walkways draped in vibrant bougainvillea flowers and wooden benches facing the dam waters.

rest_areas.name: Badami Cave Entrance Garden & Lake Verandas
rest_areas.description: Landscaped garden at the base of the caves before the stone staircase ascent. Features polished stone benches and shaded alcoves under ancient cliff faces overlooking Agastya lake.

rest_areas.name: Aihole Durga Temple Lawn Resting Pavilion
rest_areas.description: Covered wooden and stone pavilion situated on the edge of the manicured green lawn, offering a shaded resting vantage point directly facing the apsidal temple pillared colonnade.

senior_citizen_recommendations.advice: Plan monument visits during the golden morning hours (07:30 AM to 10:30 AM) or gentle late afternoons (04:00 PM to 06:30 PM). Red sandstone monument stones become hot between 12:00 PM and 03:00 PM. Carry an umbrella or sun hat and wear comfortable cushioned walking shoes with non-slip soles.

Badami Caves 1 to 4 require climbing over 250 carved sandstone steps with high risers. For seniors with osteoarthritis, hypertension, or knee concerns: do NOT attempt the full staircase. Instead, enjoy the ground-level ASI museum and entrance garden, then take an auto-rickshaw or taxi to the northern bank of Agastya Lake (Bhootanatha Temple) where the caves can be admired and photographed completely step-free across the water.

Take advantage of on-site transit: Kudala Sangama offers free battery-operated golf buggies from the parking lot straight to temple doors. At Pattadakal and Aihole, request an ASI wheelchair at the ticket office by showing senior citizen ID (Aadhaar or Senior Card) free of charge.

Emergency infrastructure in the district: Taluk General Hospital Badami: (08357) 220233 (2 km from caves). 24x7 Government Primary Health Centre & Ambulance at Kudala Sangama: On-site near police outpost. Bagalkote District Central Civil Hospital: (08354) 235333 (Sector 48, Navanagar). Statewide Emergency Ambulance Hotline: Dial 108. Police Tourist Helpline: Dial 112. District Disaster Management: Dial 1077.

Traditional Uttara Karnataka cuisine is wholesome, but spices (chilli and garlic chutneys) can be pungent. When ordering Jolada Rotti meals at local Khanavalis, politely request 'Swalpa Khara' (less spicy) or enjoy soft curd rice (Majjige Anna) with mild dal (Saaru). Fresh tender coconut water (Bonda) is sold outside all major monuments and provides clean natural electrolytes.

baby_care_facilities.locations: Almatti Dam Gardens, Pattadakal UNESCO Complex, Kudala Sangama Promenade
baby_care_facilities.details: Wide, level-grade paved concrete and asphalt pathways allow parents to push lightweight baby strollers and heavy prams effortlessly without jarring bumps. Gentle ramped turnstiles at ticketing gates ensure seamless stroller entry.

baby_care_facilities.locations: Kudala Sangama Dasoha Complex, Almatti Tourist Info Center, Badami Tourist Reception Plaza
baby_care_facilities.details: Dedicated curtain-partitioned nursing corners and air-ventilated baby-care cubicles equipped with comfortable padded armchairs, diaper-changing tables, and hygienic handwash sinks for privacy and comfort.

baby_care_facilities.locations: All ASI Ticket Plazas, KSTDC Mayura Restaurants, Verified Local Khanavalis
baby_care_facilities.details: Complimentary RO purified drinking water refill taps available at all ASI ticket counters. Verified local restaurants and Khanavalis happily provide boiled warm drinking water and warm cow/buffalo milk for baby formula bottles upon polite request.

baby_care_facilities.locations: Bagalkote Mother & Child Hospital (MCH Navanagar), Badami Taluk Maternity Clinic, Kudala Sangama PHC
baby_care_facilities.details: Government Mother & Child Hospital (MCH) in Navanagar Bagalkote operates a dedicated 24x7 Pediatric Emergency Unit. Primary pediatric trauma care, oral rehydration salts (ORS), and pediatric nurses available at Badami Taluk Hospital (2 km from caves).
